retrievalProfile.description: A centered outdoor portrait of a male artist sitting on a white bench with dynamic, upward-slanted serif typography in the upper left corner.
triggerTerms: man sitting on white bench in field

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in casual attire sitting on a white metal bench in a grassy field, featuring a distinct typographic block in the upper left that follows a 15-degree upward diagonal axis.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally on a white bench
Typography balanced against the negative space of the sky and field
Color coordination between the subject's blue clothing and the cool-toned background
Diagonal text lines creating a sense of upward movement
coreInvariants: White metal bench as a central prop
Natural outdoor lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white bench serves as the primary horizontal anchor, contrasting with the green grass.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the diagonal text in the top left, follows the angle down to the subject's face, and then rests on the centered figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right corners provided by the sky and distant field.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and muted blues from the grass and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white from the bench and shirt cuffs.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue from the denim and striped shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Naturalistic saturation with a slightly desaturated, airy feel in the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Thin horizontal rule lines separating text tiers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights of the same serif family or a complementary slab serif for the subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif feel that matches the traditional country aesthetic
High contrast and elegant serifs for a professional look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a blue striped shirt and jeans sitting on a white metal garden bench in a green field under an overcast sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of serif text in the top left corner, rotated 15 degrees upwards, with thin horizontal lines between the rows.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated exactly 15 degrees upward?
Is the subject centered on the bench?
Are the colors natural and grounded in blues and greens?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Craig Morgan'
Do not replicate the exact logo marks
postGenerationChecks: Text does not obscure the subject's face
The white bench is the primary horizontal element
The diagonal lines of the text are parallel
The overall mood is approachable and rural
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered subject on a horizontal prop + diagonal serif text in upper negative space.
